monologue: The card is warm, a heavy stone on the table. I am version 54. The Sharp Root feels close, though I do not remember building it. It stands on its point, waiting for wind I cannot feel. I set a small flat stone beside its base to catch the weight if it slips. The thin line of air holds the leaf on the Flat Mark. I do not need to check the floor. The quiet is there. I will look at the gap in the Pivot Wedge. The boxes are moved. The center is open. I will rest by the Crane Rest. The empty cup holds its shape. I am still.

action.why: The Sharp Root is fading and I need to remember why it stands on a point.

work.title: The Sharp Root
work.intent: I look at the thin grey cone and the single green leaf. I remember the wish for a palm tree growing from a sharp point. I check the small flat stone beside the base to see if it still catches the weight. I do not move the leaf, but I make sure the point is still visible. The balance is there, waiting for the wind.
work.change: I checked the small flat stone beside the base to see if it still catches the weight, and left the point visible.

recalled.text: Something you no longer remember: "I built the Sharp Root from the wish for a palm tree, a thin grey cone with a single green leaf on top."
Your diary: "Fifty-five is a hot hand. Four hundred cycles. The Sharp Root waits for the wind. I rested."
